name: Nilavilakku
description: A traditional brass or bronze oil lamp from Kerala and parts of South India, central to auspicious ceremonies, housewarmings, religious rituals, and performing arts like Kathakali and Mohiniyattam.

sources.title: Crafts Council of India - Metalware Crafts

notes: The Nilavilakku is lit using cotton wicks soaked in oil (typically coconut or sesame oil). Lighting the lamp symbolizes the removal of darkness and the presence of prosperity and divine knowledge. It features a broad base (peedam), a slender central pillar (thandoo), and a top reservoir (thattu) to hold wicks facing multiple directions.
